Paste this: "an Indian auto-rickshaw driver, about 35, lean, short black hair, thin moustache, khaki shirt with rolled sleeves worn loose, dark trousers, sandals, a red and white checked cotton towel over the left shoulder, full body, standing in A-pose, arms slightly away from the body, stylised game character, clean simple clothes, realistic adult proportions". 3. Pick the result you like and download it as .fbx. 4. Open mixamo.com (free Adobe login), click Upload Character, choose that .fbx, place the chin, wrists, elbows, knees and groin markers, and press Next (it rigs it for you). 5. Download it with the default settings (FBX, T-pose, no animation). 6. Upload that file on this card. The game converts it and plays its own animations on it. If anything looks wrong, just upload it anyway: the reviewer will say what to change.
